$comment: Single source of truth for webpet tests excluded from COLLECTION (not skipped — a skip still shows in the report). Read by playwright.config.ts, which applies `files` as testIgnore and `tag` as grepInvert, and by scripts/webpet/ids-check.js, which exempts the listed ids from its live-row rule. Their runner rows carry stale=true so webpet:runner:check stays green. To re-enable: clear the entry here, set stale='' on the row, run `npm run webpet:runner:sync`.
reason: These specs diff the web result against a baseline file produced by the legacy WinForms app on the windows-automation host (C:\Scripts\*.yaml). No CI runner — GitHub-hosted or self-hosted — has that file, so they could only ever report as skipped noise.
